name: Therefore, In Short, Then
effect: The altered model gets lost in logical connectives and filler transitions ('however', 'in short', 'then', 'therefore', 'so then', 'consequently'). Answers either collapse into repeating loops of these words or turn into confused, empty ramb
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed only in the earlier run with six candidates per packet; judged alone, it failed a check.
